id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

REDUX_METADATA_NAMESPACE.description: The data Redux namespace that indicates where the data is stored in the Redux state.

effectTriggers.description:
Mark the effect type to use when the corresponding trigger action is triggered.
Overwrite effectType if want to use different async effect.

sendRequestWithFalsyContextVars.description:
Whether or not this {@link UiSdlComponentDataSpec} should send requests even if context vars are not resolved
to a truthy value. Overrides {@link UiSdlConfig#ignoreRequestsWithFalsyContextVars}

dataTransforms.description:
List of data transform types, which will be applied after the data is
received but before saving it in the state.

Constraint: These types must extend {@link UiSdlDataTransform}.

tunnelConfiguration.description: When not empty, data and metadata will be retrieved from the specified tunnel.

c3arguments.description: The arguments to be provided with the data request.

additionalFilters.description:
Used when c3function in the `dataSource` is `fetch`.
The filter in the `dataSource` is combined with the values of the map when making the fetch request.
The key is the metadataId of the component updating the filter; the value is the filter.

edits.description: The changes that are made to the data source. This key is `id`; value is an array of fields modified .

children.description: Children components to render within this component
